scripts.ios:dev: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=development expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install && cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=development expo run:ios
scripts.ios:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install && cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.export:dev: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=development expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/development
scripts.export:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 APP_VARIANT=production expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/production
